capabilities: Create interactive task trees with nested subtasks in custom .tree files
Enforce parent-task completion rules based on subtask status
Focus on a single task branch to hide unrelated work
Edit trees in a graph view or a YAML text editor with live validation
Link tasks to Obsidian notes and filter by status, priority, or tag
extras: Not published in the Community Plugins listing; installed manually from a local build. Requires Obsidian 1.6.0 or newer.
motivation: Flat to-do lists get overwhelming when projects grow, so the author built visual task trees for the vault.
problem: Flat to-do lists become overwhelming as projects grow, and Obsidian's task lists offer no hierarchical, visual structure with completion dependencies.

relations.evidence: install and enable the Hot Reload plugin. It detects .hotreload and automatically reloads Tree Work

summary: Task tree manager that breaks projects into visual, nested task trees with dependency rules, focus mode, and a YAML text editor, stored in .tree files.
